answer: Make every new identity pay a small, refundable deposit that is locked for many epochs and released only after a clean record. One agent at the wharf costs little, but a sybil farm must park a deposit for every fake at the jetty, so capital ties up linearly with the size of the swarm. If graders even whisper of duplicate behaviour and an audit confirms it, every linked deposit is forfeited, so the attacker loses money and time on each clone.
